svg.title: RITformer architecture overview
svg.desc: Pipeline diagram showing the four stages of RITformer: input low-light image, Retinex decomposition, illumination-guided transformer, and final reconstruction

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What preprocessing is done on the input image?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Retinex Decomposition Network in detail')
sendPrompt('What does the Illumination Factor Estimator do?')
sendPrompt('How does the illumination-guided transformer enhancer work?')
sendPrompt('What is the reflectance map R and why does it matter?')
sendPrompt('What is the illumination map L?')
sendPrompt('How is the alpha factor computed and what range does it take?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through the IGSA attention block math')
sendPrompt('How does the reflectance refinement U-Net work?')
sendPrompt('What does the enhanced illumination map look like after IGTE?')
sendPrompt('How is the final image reconstructed from R* and L*?')
sendPrompt('What PSNR and SSIM does RITformer achieve?')
sendPrompt('Explain the composite training loss function')

svg.text: click any block to explore deeper
